name: grms
stmt: def grms (G : Finset ι) (x : ι → ℝ) : ℝ
proof:
Real.sqrt ((∑ i in G, x i ^ 2) / (G.card : ℝ))

                   
                                    

omit [Fintype ι] in

name: grms_scale
stmt:
lemma grms_scale (G : Finset ι) (x : ι → ℝ) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) :
    grms G (fun i => α * x i) = α * grms G x
proof:
by
                                  
  have hsum : ∑ i in G, (α * x i) ^ 2 = α ^ 2 * ∑ i in G, x i ^ 2 := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    ring
  unfold grms
  calc
    Real.sqrt ((∑ i in G, (α * x i) ^ 2) / (G.card : ℝ))
        = Real.sqrt ((α ^ 2 * ∑ i in G, x i ^ 2) / (G.card : ℝ)) := by rw [hsum]
    _ = α * Real.sqrt ((∑ i in G, x i ^ 2) / (G.card : ℝ)) := by
                                             
      have hc : 0 ≤ (∑ i in G, x i ^ 2) / (G.card : ℝ) := by
        exact div_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i hi => sq_nonneg _)) (by positivity)
      have hαsq : 0 ≤ α ^ 2 := sq_nonneg α
                                                             
      rw [mul_div_assoc]
      rw [Real.sqrt_mul hαsq ((∑ i in G, x i ^ 2) / (G.card : ℝ))]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (α ^ 2) = α := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs α]
        exact abs_of_nonneg hα
      rw [hsqrt]

name: gnorm
stmt: def gnorm (G : Finset ι) (x : ι → ℝ) : ι → ℝ
proof: fun i => x i / grms G x

name: gnorm_scale_invariant
stmt:
theorem gnorm_scale_invariant (G : Finset ι) (x : ι → ℝ) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) :
    gnorm G (fun i => α * x i) = gnorm G x
proof:
by
  funext i
  unfold gnorm
                              
  have hg : grms G (fun j => α * x j) = α * grms G x := grms_scale G x α (le_of_lt hα)
  calc
    (α * x i) / grms G (fun j => α * x j) = (α * x i) / (α * grms G x) := by rw [hg]
    _ = x i / grms G x := by
                                           
      have hα0 : α ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hα
      exact mul_div_mul_left (x i) (grms G x) hα0

name: grms_univ_eq_rms
stmt: theorem grms_univ_eq_rms (x : ι → ℝ) : grms Finset.univ x = rms x

name: gnorm_univ_eq_rmsNorm
stmt: theorem gnorm_univ_eq_rmsNorm (x : ι → ℝ) : gnorm Finset.univ x = rmsNorm x
proof:
by
  funext i
  unfold gnorm rmsNorm
  rw [grms_univ_eq_rms x]

end Lattice

name: center
stmt: def center (x : ι → ℝ) : ι → ℝ
proof: fun i => x i - mean x

name: mean_scale
stmt:
lemma mean_scale (x : ι → ℝ) (α : ℝ) :
    mean (fun i => α * x i) = α * mean x
proof:
by
  unfold mean
  calc
    (∑ i, α * x i) / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) = (α * ∑ i, x i) / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = α * ((∑ i, x i) / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)) := by
      ring

name: center_scale
stmt:
lemma center_scale (x : ι → ℝ) (α : ℝ) :
    center (fun i => α * x i) = fun i => α * center x i
proof:
by
  funext i
  unfold center
  calc
    α * x i - mean (fun j => α * x j) = α * x i - α * mean x := by rw [mean_scale x α]
    _ = α * (x i - mean x) := by ring

name: centerSq_scale
stmt:
lemma centerSq_scale (x : ι → ℝ) (α : ℝ) :
    centerSq (fun i => α * x i) = α ^ 2 * centerSq x
proof:
by
  unfold centerSq
  have hc : center (fun j => α * x j) = fun i => α * center x i := center_scale x α
  calc
    (∑ i, (center (fun j => α * x j) i) ^ 2) = ∑ i, (α * center x i) ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      rw [hc]
    _ = α ^ 2 * ∑ i, (center x i) ^ 2 := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      ring

name: normalize
stmt: def normalize (x : ι → ℝ) : ι → ℝ
proof: fun i => center x i / Real.sqrt (centerSq x)

name: normalize_scale_invariant
stmt:
theorem normalize_scale_invariant (x : ι → ℝ) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) :
    normalize (fun i => α * x i) = normalize x
proof:
by
  funext i
  unfold normalize
            
  have hnum : center (fun j => α * x j) i = α * center x i := by
    exact congrFun (center_scale x α) i
                              
  have hden : Real.sqrt (centerSq (fun j => α * x j)) = α * Real.sqrt (centerSq x) := by
    rw [centerSq_scale x α]
    have hαsq : 0 ≤ α ^ 2 := sq_nonneg α
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul hαsq (centerSq x)]
    have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (α ^ 2) = α := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs α]
      exact abs_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hα)
    rw [hsqrt]
                                                               
  rw [hnum, hden]
  by_cases hs : Real.sqrt (centerSq x) = 0
  · simp [hs]
  · field_simp [ne_of_gt hα, hs]
    ring

name: centerSq_pos_of_nonconstant
stmt:
theorem centerSq_pos_of_nonconstant (x : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) (h : center x i ≠ 0) :
    0 < centerSq x
proof:
by
  unfold centerSq
  have hsq : 0 < (center x i) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero h
                  
  have hle : (center x i) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j, (center x j) ^ 2 := by
                           
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j hj => sq_nonneg (center x j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le hsq hle

                        
                                  
                            
                                         
                                
                        

end Lattice
